deploybot: PROD deploy initiated by jen.release — env=production region=us-west-2 tag=v3.6.2 commit=6a2f3b789a canary=5% window=03:00-03:30UTC
jen.release: kicking off canary, watching latency and errors. feature flags toggled for risky endpoints :eyes:
alex: core-rewrite flag is OFF in prod. canary go ahead.
deploybot: canary rollout -> 5% complete. smoke checks scheduled.
ops-bot: smoke-checks: health OK, replicas healthy, disk <70%, model p50=120ms p95=210ms
monitoring-bot: note: small spike in request_error_rate to 0.82% (threshold 1.0%) around +3m — investigating
sam: seeing transient 429s on non-critical routing (likely warmup). holding at 25% for 5m to verify.
jen.release: holding sounds right. do not escalate yet, just keep eyes on SRE dashboards.
deploybot: rolling to 25% now — 10 instances in canary slice. continuous checks enabled.
ops-bot: cache warmup observed, p95 trending down to 190ms after warmup
marta: CS FYI — no customer reports so far. logging minor retry noise in logs.
jen.release: proceed to 75% after the 5m hold if metrics steady.
deploybot: traffic shifted to 75% — running post-shift validation (latency/error/throughput).
monitoring-bot: validation snapshot: error_rate back to baseline (0.12%), latency within SLOs.
alex: pinning prod to tag v3.6.2 (commit 6a2f3b789a) — disabling auto-rollback for this release :white_check_mark:
deploybot: final traffic shift -> 100% complete. tag=v3.6.2 commit=6a2f3b789a
ops-bot: post-rollout checks passed: service-health=green, tail errors <0.1%, cpu stable
monitoring-bot: no sustained anomalies detected in last 10m. alerting quiet.
jen.release: release notes published: https://redwood-internal/release/3.6.2 — includes API changes and quants tweak
marta: thanks — will ping CS & SRE channels to monitor for 30m and collect any customer issues
sam: prepping quick rollback playbook just in case, but all looks stable now.
deploybot: PROD deploy finished by jen.release — duration=12m34s status=SUCCESS commit=6a2f3b789a tag=v3.6.2
jen.release: great work team :tada: I’ll post a short summary in #eng-announce and follow up with any telemetry notes.
sam: nice job everyone :thumbsup:
alex: closing the run — will add a note to the release ticket with the canary metrics.
